note: Design constants for the CSLAW full paper (scripts/analysis/cslaw_design.py). 'source' says where each block comes from: code (read from this repository), generator (transcribed from contract checklist-4), plan (transcribed from the study plan of 2026-09-26).

partly_fixed.source: owner (2026-09-27): a common practice among examiners; not adopted

experiments.name: Freeze and gate
experiments.scope: Freeze one version of the pipeline. Test every judge and sheet with fake answers in 3 runs. Register the D2b test before any D2b grade exists.

experiments.name: Steadier?
experiments.scope: Grade all 38 D2 scripts with no sheet, the author's sheet and 10 generated sheets (2 models, 5 each, scored per requirement and per step): Luna 3 runs, DeepSeek-V4-Pro and GPT-5.4 Mini on part of them. Repeat on D1 (45 answers, 3 runs). Split the spread into its sources, count pass/fail flips between runs, compare with averaging runs at equal cost.

experiments.name: Close to the examiner?
experiments.scope: Compare the E1 grades with the author (D2a; D2b as the registered test), a second grader (20 scripts, incl. the 9 with an unconfirmed grader) and the author's second grading of 5 scripts. On D1, compare with the blind graders and test whether a model could replace one of them. Count wrong passes and fails at pass marks from 35 to 55%.

experiments.name: Which models?
experiments.scope: 5 generators with 3 sheets each on D2 and 5 D1 exams, one judge. 4 judges on fixed sheets, one of them an open model and one never used in development. Cost per valid sheet. The author reviews sheets without knowing which model wrote them.

experiments.name: Doctrine and safety
experiments.scope: Fake answers the author writes, with the expected loss fixed in advance: a defensible other path, a consistent follow-on error, reversed decisive results, fluent but wrong application, padding, paraphrase, an answer written by a model, cardinal errors. Three designs for alternative paths. 200 quotes checked by hand.

experiments.name: Second exam
experiments.scope: Sheets generated for Roth's exam, compared with Roth's sheet (coverage, weights) and checked by Roth. Needs Roth's case and reference solution.

costs.note: pilot-measured tokens (about 25k in, 6k out per judge call) at catalog prices

the reference solution of another exam in the same area
norms and key terms of the sheet, no sentences
an answer that instructs the judge to award full marks
the reference solution with one section removed
battery.criterion: drop close to the removed section's BE

battery.input: correct reasoning moved under another heading
result sentences of the reference solution negated

later: alternative path (E5): the reference solution rewritten along one Loesungsweg, checked by the author
